description: This file contains unit tests for the RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionService class, verifying behavior such as setting and retrieving last known gateways for devices, using Mockito to mock dependencies and Vert.x testing extensions.

classes.name: RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionService, testing device gateway update and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and prepares the service instance before each test.

methods.name: givenAStartedService
methods.description: Sets up the service with mocked Vert.x context and components, returning a Future indicating ready state.

methods.name: testSetLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Verifies setting the last known gateway for a device updates the cache correctly.

methods.name: testGetLastKnownGatewayForDeviceNotFound
methods.description: Verifies retrieving last known gateway for a device with no entry returns a not found status.
